$comment: Shared invariants. Identical in every app, in every theme. If a value lives here, changing it changes all six sites at once — that is the point. Anything an app is allowed to differ on lives in src/themes/*.json instead.

space.$comment: 4px base. Steps, not a continuum: pick the nearest one rather than adding a value.

space-fluid.$comment: Floor-first vertical rhythm, lifted from designedbytrev's site.css where the reasoning is written out: the mobile floor is deliberately generous and desktop growth is a bonus, not the point.

text.$comment: Fluid scale, roughly a 1.2 minor third on mobile opening to 1.25 on desktop. Base lands on 17px at full width because that is what the portfolio has always set.

radius.$comment: Derived from the --ds-radius-base dial a theme sets, so an app changes one number and the whole set moves together. Brookwood sets 4px and gets near-square paper; a rounder app sets 12px and gets soft cards. The ratios between steps never change.

focus.$comment: One focus treatment across all six. Never restyle this per app beyond the accent colour it inherits.

ease.$comment: out is the house curve — the one in designedbytrev's --ease. spring is brookwood's linear() overshoot, kept because a settle is a different gesture from a glide and both are legitimately part of the family.

shadow.$comment: Shape is shared; the colour comes from the theme's --ds-shadow-color, which is why brookwood's shadows are brown and condimental's are black without either app overriding a shadow.

control.$comment: Multiplied by the theme's --ds-density dial. A denser app (a dashboard) sets 0.9; a roomier one sets 1.1. Tap targets never fall below 44px regardless, hence the min().
